title: Black Bob Thunderbird figurine
subtitle: Chibi figurine of the costume mascot · 80 mm tall on a display base · red, white, black · millimetres

meshes.label: White (beak, eyeballs, highlights, chest blaze, legs, feet, B B)

scale_note: 80 mm tall is a first guess for a 'little' figurine. Type a different height in the real-size box to preview it; HEIGHT_MM in build.py sets it.
notes: v12 (you circled the bump at the back of the lower beak). Once the head was narrowed, the back of the lower jaw and the mouth corners stuck out past the head's lower edge. The jaw is now narrower and tapers toward the back, and the mouth corners are smaller and tucked in, so from the side the lower beak runs smoothly into the head. The mouth opening narrows toward the back to stay inside the slimmer beak. The top of the chest blaze is lowered a little, because it was peeking through the mouth. Everything else is as in v11.
